record.rate_text: 100% surtax applied 1 Oct 2024 – 28 Feb 2026; repealed 1 Mar 2026 and replaced by an import quota of 49,000 units/year — 6.1% MFN inside quota, no imports above quota
record.stacks_on: Quota regime replaces the surtax (not stacked)
record.source_note: China Surtax Order (2024), SOR/2024-187 · Order Amending the China Surtax Order (2024), SOR/2026-33 · Import Control List Order (2026-1), SOR/2026-32 · CBSA Customs Notice 24-32 · CITT expiry review RR-2025-008 · CBSA SIMA measures-in-force list
record.note: effective_from takes the effective date of the current quota regime; the original surtax period (1 Oct 2024 - 28 Feb 2026) is in rate_text and status_history. One row carrying two successive regimes follows the original tracker row structure; the chain is recorded in status_history.
